project_type: Monorepo: Python FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Worker edge + Vite React frontend
build_command: N/A - this is a standalone bash script
verification_instructions: Run bash -n scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh for syntax validation, then count pass/fail/warn/skip calls to verify 1000+ test assertions
setup_instructions: No setup needed - script uses curl/jq/openssl against live deployment
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Script targets live deployment URLs. bash, curl, jq, openssl all available.
contribution_requirements: Keep same CLI interface (--help, --dry-run, --layer N, --quick). Keep same env var configuration. Keep bash/curl/jq only (no external deps).
key_patterns: Existing script uses: perform_request() for timed curl, pass()/fail()/warn()/skip() for assertions, section_header() for layer starts, LAYER_RESULTS array, JSON export, color output. Each layer is a function test_layer_N_name().
directory_structure: scripts/ contains fullstack-layer-test.sh (target file). apps/backend/app/api/v1/ has all route handlers. apps/edge/src/ has the Cloudflare Worker.
